name: smwsprites-thermal-key
title: Thermal Key
description:
This key can actually change its own temperature, enabling (and restricting) access to temperature-sensitive doors. There are 3 states of the key: normal, frozen, and blazing.

Included are the 3 temperature-sensitive doors (GPS blocks).

Read the readme for more info (like coding your own blocks for this)!

Tester's note: Original idea, and nice execution of it!
